## Goal
A user page for the app's "Protect yourself" screen (nav `src/freemyid/wizard/ui.py:43`, page `src/freemyid/wizard/views.py:252-265`), led by credit freezes. Then a read-only check of the website's credit-freeze guide against the app's list, reported as findings.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Quotes the page's lead text (`views.py:254-257`: optional, mostly free, "The ticks stay on this computer") and the buttons "Open the web page" (`views.py:215`) and "I did this" / "I have not done this" (`views.py:218`).
- Lists the freeze steps by their exact titles in `brokers/checklists.yaml` (lines 22-165: Equifax, Experian, TransUnion, Innovis, ChexSystems, NCTUE, LexisNexis, child freeze), cited in words. The other steps (lines 188-319) get one line each. No web address, phone number or fee that isn't in that file.
- Explains in plain words what a freeze does and doesn't do, and that you lift it yourself when you apply for credit, only as far as `brokers/checklists.yaml` supports; otherwise "ask the bureau".
- Repeats the app's promise: Free My ID never pays and never asks for a Social Security number or bank or card details (`views.py:273`); the bureau's own site may ask for your Social Security number, and that is the bureau, not Free My ID.
- Guide check: compare `web/src/pages/protect/credit-freeze/index.astro` (read-only) with `brokers/checklists.yaml`. Every mismatch (a bureau missing, a different address or claim) goes in VENDOR_STATUS.md as a finding with file:line on both sides. Don't edit either file.
- Expected: `tests/copilot/test_cp_user_docs_reachable.py` fails exactly one case, `test_user_page_is_reachable[protect-yourself.md]`, because nothing links the new page yet. That is by design: WO-330 links it, and in-house merges this WO and WO-330 together before pushing. Record that one failure in VENDOR_STATUS.md; any other failure is yours to fix.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.

Page rules (new help pages, WO-311..320):
- Quote screen text and button labels exactly as the app shows them, with the source as `src/freemyid/<path>.py:NNN` in an HTML comment on the same line. `tests/copilot/test_cp_source_citations.py` checks that the line exists and that quoted text on that line is in that file. Cite anything that isn't under `src/freemyid/` in words ("brokers/checklists.yaml, line 22"; "packaging/windows/splash_win.py, line 20"), because only `src/freemyid/` files resolve.
- Link only to pages that exist on main today. Don't link to other new pages in this batch: WO-330 adds the help-topics page that links them all.
- First line under the title: who the page is for and what it helps with, in one sentence. Then short sentences (about 15 words), one step per line, numbered steps. No screenshots (none can be made offline). No web addresses except ones the app itself shows; never a GitHub link for regular users.
